meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 安装 OneCLI 并初始化 Agent Vault，将 .env 中的凭据迁移到 vault 中，然后构建并重启服务。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 破坏性变更后，或首次设置 OneCLI 时使用。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI Agent Vault。
把 .env 里的 Anthropic 密钥迁移到 vault。
检查 OneCLI 是否已安装并配置好。

howto.what_en: Install OneCLI and initialize the Agent Vault, migrate existing .env credentials into the vault, then build and restart the service.
howto.when_en: Use after /update-nanoclaw brings OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.text: Initialize the OneCLI Agent Vault for me.
Migrate the Anthropic keys from .env to the vault.
Check if OneCLI is already installed and configured.
